desc: THE CHURCHILL 620 HOME DEFENSE 20GA 3″ PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN was designed to work flawlessly as a home protection firearm, with it’s 18.5″ barrel maneuvering in tight situations becomes an easy task. Featuring a durable synthetic stock and forend, aluminum receiver, and a front fixed sight this pump-action will be ready to operate when needed.
